# nico_machine_validation (Data Source)

Machine Validation is the mechanism through which a series of validation tests are executed against a Machine verify its integrity. The tests are run for each Machine on ingestion, they can also be run on-demand.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_machine_validation" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "machine_validation_name" {
  value = data.nico_machine_validation.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `machine_id` (String) Path parameter: machine_id.

### Read-Only

- `context` (String) Context in which the validation run was created.
- `duration_to_complete_secs` (Number) Estimated maximum duration of the validation run in seconds. A value of zero can mean the estimate has not yet been calculated.
- `end_time` (String) Time the validation run completed, or null while it is active.
- `name` (String) Name of the validation run.
- `start_time` (String) Time the validation run started.
- `status` (Attributes) Progress and outcome of a Machine validation run (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))
- `validation_id` (String) ID of the Machine validation run.

<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `completed` (Number) Number of validation tests that have completed.
- `state` (String) Current state or completed outcome of the validation run.
- `total` (Number) Total number of validation tests in the run.
